obligations.subject: Authority and dependency drift
obligations.trigger: When a frozen Package B dependency, boundary or verification rule drifts
obligations.state_before: An existing scoped plan or execution witness is bound to its original inputs
obligations.state_after: Affected scope stopped until a legitimate repair/successor is validated
obligations.expected_behavior: Stop and use a repair/successor path if an accepted standard, ADR, schema, validator, command or dependency hash changes.
obligations.observable_result: Changed accepted inputs are not silently reused as the old frozen execution contract.
forbidden_result: Changed authority or stale evidence is silently treated as a current validated contract
